LESSON: ATTENTIVE LISTENING: SIMPLE INSTRUCTIONS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.3: Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you improve your listening skills?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. respond to instructions related to the theme for comprehension

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: ATTENTIVE LISTENING: SIMPLE INSTRUCTIONS
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions helps you succeed in ARABIC LANGUAGE. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: ATTENTIVE LISTENING: SIMPLE INSTRUCTIONS
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Respond to instructions related to the theme for comprehension

What this means
In this part you learn to respond to instructions related to the theme for comprehension. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: respond to instructions related to the theme for comprehension.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can respond to instructions related to the theme for comprehension. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: respond to instructions related to the theme for comprehension)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: respond to instructions related to the theme for comprehension.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you improve your listening skills?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: respond to instructions related to the theme for comprehension.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
